summary: Brera Holdings PLC (NASDAQ: SLMT), now operating as Solmate Infrastructure, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 18, 2026 press release; CEO Ron Sade called the SOL token undervalued and announced an investor presentation at Solana's Capital Forum alongside TOKEN2049 in Singapore. Solmate disclosed holdings of approximately 1.24 million SOL tokens valued near $125 million. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is referenced. The 6-K is informational disclosure, so the arbitrage angle is nil; watch for any subsequent SOL accumulation or corporate-action announcements.
